text:
Alisa: FYI ap-southeast1 had a burst of GPU pod evictions 06:12-06:27 UTC. ~120 evictions, realtime queues spiking.
Jun: Looking at node telemetry nowNVLink retransmit rate jumped and conntrack table churned on warm-pool nodes. Attach calls timed out at kubelet layer.
Priya: Are these the tiny-gang fractional jobs again?
Alisa: Mostly fractional/gang jobs and some short RL evals. They scatter across racks and cause NVLink congestion when concentrated.
Mike: Repro on a mini-rack: when 6 tiny-gang jobs land and NVLink is busy, attach latency goes >2.5s, autoscaler retries, and scheduler preempts under current 5s preempt window.
Jun: Immediate idea: increase device attach timeout & backoff, widen scheduler preempt window in that region to reduce cascade. Also, prefer one warm-pool node pool to receive tiny-gangs (soft prefer).
Priya: Throttle new tiny-gang launches in ap-southeast1 for 12-24h while we stabilize. Add a short quota so the autoscaler won't flood.
Alisa: Proposed quick changes to test in canary:
```yaml
# scheduler tweaks
minPreemptionTimeSeconds: 30
# autoscaler tweak
tinyGangMaxConcurrent: 50
# attach settings
nvidia.attach.timeoutSeconds: 8
nvidia.attach.maxRetries: 4
```
Jun: Ops plan to isolate warm pool:
1) label nodepool: kubectl label nodepool ap-southeast1-warm1 pool=prefer-isol
2) patch tiny-gang controller to add soft nodeAffinity -> prefer pool=prefer-isol
This avoids hard taints.
Mike: Agree. Also add a short alert: if attach latency > 2s for 5m -> mute aggressive scale-up decisions and page platform-owner.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: scheduler + attach-config -> ap-southeast1-canary (id: can-17578). Logs in #eng-platform-deploys.
Priya: I've opened a quota CR (CR-4521) to cap tiny-gang concurrency and linked runbook note.
Alisa: After canary we should watch: evictions/minute, attach latency p50/p95, NVLink retransmits, and cost delta for resubmits.
Jun: If canary looks good after 30m, roll to region. If not, rollback and escalate to infra oncall.
Mike: Follow-up long-term: build job-sensitivity metadata so scheduler can set evictionPriority and avoid preempting critical realtime workloads. Also evaluate soft-affinity packing to reduce cross-rack NVLink pressure.
Alisa: Thanks all. Rolling canary now. I'll post a short incident summary + numbers in the channel after 2h. :thumbsup:
